subject: ClearPoint: proposed multi-leg security walkthrough and evidence sprint
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@clearpoint.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ClearPoint: proposed multi-leg security walkthrough and evidence sprint

Hi Marta —

Thanks again for the time on the call yesterday. Based on the scope (SOC 2 readiness + DPA review + lightweight pen test intake) it looks like the most practical approach is a multi-leg walkthrough: one session focused on controls & SOC 2 scope and a companion session for pen-test intake and evidence handoff. That avoids a single 3.5hr block for your team and gives us a clear handover for ops.

Proposed plan (quick):
- Session A (controls + SOC 2): 90 minutes — run through system architecture, control owners, and evidence locations.
- Session B (pen test intake + DPA specifics): 60–75 minutes — requirements, test scoping, and evidence transfer procedures.
- Ops handover: 15–20 minute overlap or recorded handoff so our on-call can pick up.

Attached is a preliminary evidence checklist and a short questionnaire (redwood-evidence-checklist.pdf, clearpoint-questions-v1.xlsx) to help the control owners prepare. If this sounds good, please pick two 90/75 minute slots and we will provide the Ops bridge link.

Availability from our side this week:
- Thu 6/24: 10:30–13:00 PT
- Fri 6/25: 09:00–12:00 PT or 15:00–17:00 PT (we can split across days)

If your team needs EMEA-friendly times instead we can propose an AM/PM split and include a short overlap window for handoff.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@clearpoint.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@clearpoint.com>
Date: 2027-06-24T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearPoint: proposed multi-leg security walkthrough and evidence sprint

Thanks Jonas — this makes sense and we like the multi-leg idea. A couple of constraints from our side:
- Our Head of Security (Oliver) is only available Fri 6/25 after 14:00 PT.
- Control owners are distributed across NY and London; they prefer shorter focused sessions rather than a single long block.

Can we do:
- Session A (SOC 2 controls): Thu 6/24 16:00–17:30 ET (that’s Fri 6/25 09:00–10:30 UK time) — this lets our London owner join.
- Session B (pen test intake + DPA): Fri 6/25 14:15–15:30 PT — Oliver can join the latter.

We also have a short internal questionnaire for scoping (I’ll attach it here if needed) — happy to prefill parts of your checklist. Please confirm the Ops bridge details and whether you need additional artifacts (network diagrams, SaaS data flows) beforehand.

Best,
Marta
Security Programs Lead, ClearPoint Financial
Marta.Ruiz@clearpoint.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@clearpoint.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-24T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearPoint: proposed multi-leg security walkthrough and evidence sprint

Perfect — thanks for the clarity, Marta. We can run with the two slots you propose. Summary and a couple of asks:

Confirmed slots (pending your final OK):
- Session A (Controls / SOC 2): Thu 2027-06-24 13:00–14:30 PT (16:00–17:30 ET) — invite will include a short agenda: architecture diagram, control mapping, evidence owners.
- Session B (Pen test intake / DPA): Fri 2027-06-25 14:15–15:30 PT — focus on scoping, sign-off path, and evidence transfer.

Requests:
1) If you can prefill any items in the attached clearpoint-questions-v1.xlsx it will speed the intake.
2) Please share a network diagram (PDF or draw.io) and a list of external integrations for Session A if available.

Operational notes:
- Camila (cc’d) will own the Ops bridge and will send an .ics + Ops bridge link. We’ll record Session B for your legal reviewers.
- We’ll keep Session A focused on current control state (what’s in prod) and reserve detailed config-level evidence for a quick follow-up if needed.

Attaching the same checklist again and I’ll ask Camila to send the calendar invites.

Hi Marta —

Invite sent for both sessions, attached is the Ops bridge .ics and the conference link: ops-bridge-invite.ics. I also added a 15-minute overlap handoff on Fri 6/25 15:30–15:45 PT for our on-call to join and confirm any remaining evidence handoff items.

Quick checklist reminder for control owners before Session A:

For Session B please have your pen-test policy or standard scoping doc handy if possible. We will record Session B and upload the recording to the Drive folder (link in HubSpot).

Let us know if any of these times still need tweaks. Looking forward to the walkthrough —
